title: Run Large PlanetScale Queries in Laravel With DB::olap
content:
Laravel's new DB::olap() method runs PlanetScale and Vitess queries in OLAP mode to get past the 100,000 row limit, then switches the connection back.

The post Run Large PlanetScale Queries in Laravel With DB::olap() appeared first on Laravel News.
